      Controls and info

      You wake up in a cold concrete maze with water on the floor, and the lights keep dying. The walls are covered in warnings. Somewhere behind you, something heavy is getting out of bed. Find the elevator (you will hear it ding) before he finds you.

      From Floor 9 the halls can flood, and the man hears your steps in the water. Every flooded floor has a lever on a wall: pulling it drains the water, but the creaking will bring him to it. Up in a ladder attic you can walk around; go to the hole and press E to climb down.

      W A S Dmove Mouselook (click to capture) ← →turn without a mouse Shiftsprint, drains stamina Spacejump (Floor 10) Mshow or hide map Euse ladders, trapdoors and the elevator doors, break out of traps Trapsbear traps, floor 2+: tap or hold E to break free Drinksenergy drinks, floor 4+: faster stamina until you escape Trapdoorsfloor 5+: crawl under a wall where he cannot follow Laddersfloor 6+: climb up to hide in the attic Cansfloor 7+: step on a can to spill it. He slows down in the spill Waterfloor 9+: in wet halls he hears every step you take Hardno map, no red warning glow, a bit darker

      He is slower than you sprinting and faster than you walking. Each floor is bigger and he gets quicker. He sees what is in front of him and hears you run. From floor 8 there are two of them.
